facingNote: Side/three-quarter profile facing RIGHT; the engine flips horizontally for leftward travel.

dragonfly.notes: Side/three-quarter dragonfly facing right, 22x12 cell. Long segmented teal-green abdomen (ink/water-deep underside, water-mid and sky-high segments) with a leaf-green thorax; large pale-cyan eye with one cream glint and a selective ink rim. Four long translucent wings radiate around the thorax: two near wings are 2px pale blades (wing leading + foam membrane) and two far wings are 1px teal leading edges over foam; pale tips catch the light. The upper pair opens a 1px transparent gap, the lower pair tucks tight to the abdomen, and the gaps plus the alternating wing/foam tones give the translucency. Four-frame glide beat: wing tips sweep back/forward and up/down by 1-2px per frame (spans 14/13/12/15px). The body, head and tail are pixel-identical in all four frames (fully anchored, no tail flick); the only changed pixels are wings. No baked shadow.
